img.alt: Aerial view of a river splitting into channels before it meets the sea

qti-item-body.p: A river slows down when it reaches the sea, and the sand and silt it carries settle out of the water.
Watch the time-lapse clip below. It compresses forty years of satellite images of one stretch of coast into less than a minute.
Describe two changes you can see in the channels over the course of the clip, and explain what might cause each one. Write three to five sentences in your own words.
